Coil then make a strong crossing double cut, left then right blade, compact crossed slash streaks; guard crosses BOTH blades. ROW3 hit recoil and recovery; ROW4 defensive guard and recovery using this actual equipment, no extra sword; ROW5 evasive crouch step then recovery; ROW6 collapse/defeat ending lying motionless. SAME costume throughout: slender adult northern man with swept ash-blond hair, neat braid and no beard, deep blue long wool coat, ivory fur collar, bronze knotwork clasps, rune-carved belt and fitted brown boots. Weapon must remain recognizable, same proportions, grip anatomically correct. No swords except those explicitly requested. No touching neighbours. Solid opaque magenta everywhere between characters, no transparency. 6 columns, 6 rows, 36 poses.
